Foundations

REF A1Start here

About this document

This is the single source of truth for building kalkstrade.com, the public marketing website for Kalks. It holds final copy, SEO metadata, page structure, imagery direction and developer notes for every public page. Build from it directly. Copy in framed blocks is final and should be used word for word.

Scope

The website is the public front door. It explains Kalks and turns visitors into registered clients and partners. Every sign-up, log-in, deposit, trading and account-management action happens in the Client Area at app.kalkstrade.com or in the Web Terminal at trade.kalkstrade.com. The website never handles credentials, money or personal data beyond analytics consent and the contact form.

SurfaceDomainRoleOwned by this spec?
Marketing websitekalkstrade.comPublic pages, SEO, education, conversionYes
Client Area (CRM)app.kalkstrade.comRegistration, KYC, wallet, accounts, IB, copy, PAMM, propNo: only link targets
Web Terminaltrade.kalkstrade.comCharts and order executionNo: only link targets

Conventions

  • Framed copy (ember left rule) is final. Do not paraphrase it. Translators work from the English source in the i18n catalogue.
  • Bracketed fields (shown [like this]) are facts only the company can supply, such as regulator, licence number, address and client numbers. A build that still contains brackets must fail the release checklist (Appendix D6).
  • Dotted-underlined values are proposed product parameters from the platform specification (decisions D1–D150) and the Client Area mock data. Verify each one against the live admin configuration, and wherever possible render it from the config/pricing API so the website never contradicts the platform.
  • CTA notation: every button shows its label and link target. External targets open in the same tab (the Client Area is part of the same brand journey), except PDFs and third-party links.
  • Section numbers (01, 02…) give the render order from top to bottom of the page.
  • SEO limits: the build script checks every SEO title (60 characters or fewer) and meta description (155 or fewer); the counters are printed beside each field.

Compliance principles for all copy

  • No guaranteed-profit, “risk-free”, “easy money” or income-promise language anywhere, including image alt text and ad landing pages.
  • Every page that shows a leveraged product carries the global risk banner. Pages about copy trading, PAMM, prop challenges, bonuses and contests also carry their own risk note, as specified on each page.
  • Do not publish regulator names, licence numbers, awards, client counts, trading volumes or testimonials until they are real, verified and approved by compliance. The fields for them exist in this document as placeholders.
  • Execution model: Kalks acts as the counterparty to client trades at launch (see D2 and D25). Copy must never claim “no dealing desk”, “true ECN”, “STP only” or “we never trade against you”. The ECN account name describes its pricing model (raw spread plus commission); counsel should confirm the name is acceptable in each target jurisdiction.
  • Performance figures for masters, PAMM funds and strategies must be labelled “past performance is not a reliable indicator of future results”.
Developer noteKalks is tenant #1 of a white-label platform (D1). Build every brand-specific string, colour, logo and legal field from a single brand.config.ts so a second tenant can reuse the site by swapping config and copy catalogues.
REF A2Brand

Brand summary

Kalks is a global multi-asset broker for traders who take precision seriously. The brand should feel like a private trading floor at night: dark, calm and warm, with an ember glow, gold highlights, and numbers that are sharp enough to trust.

Positioning

CategoryGlobal multi-asset online broker: Forex, Metals, Indices, Energies, Crypto CFDs and Stock CFDs, plus copy trading, PAMM, prop challenges and an API for algorithmic traders.
AudiencePrimary: self-directed retail traders aged 22–45 in Asia, the Middle East, Africa and Latin America who already trade or are ready to. Secondary: introducing brokers, signal providers and strategy developers, and algorithmic and small institutional traders who need API/FIX access.
PromiseInstitutional-grade tools and clear conditions, from a $10 first deposit.
Proof pointsFour account types (Standard, Pro, ECN, Cent); raw spreads from 0.0 pips on ECN; leverage up to 1:2000 on Cent; USDT-TRC20 funding with no deposit fee from Kalks; a web terminal with in-house charting; REST, WebSocket and FIX 4.4 API; copy trading, PAMM and prop challenges in one Client Area; 20+ languages; negative balance protection.
PersonalityPremium, institutional, precise, calm, candid.
TaglinePrecision, in every market.
Alternate lines“Built for traders who read the decimals.” · “Global markets. One precise account.” · “Trade with intent.”

Visual identity (summary; tokens in Appendix D2)

  • Canvas: near-black ink #07070A with one warm ember glow bleeding in from the top of every page (--bg-glow), fading to black within about 400px. The website is dark-first; a light theme is optional for long-form legal and academy reading.
  • Accents: ember #FF5A1F for primary CTAs, active states and glow; gold #E9B949 for premium elements (Pro/ECN badges, prop, partner levels, chart lines). Green #22C55E and red #F04438 are reserved for price direction and profit/loss. Never use them decoratively.
  • Type: Geist for UI and headlines; Geist Mono for prices, logins, hashes and spec tables. Big numbers use tabular figures with dimmed decimals, e.g. 2,654.30.
  • Shapes: 20px card radius, pill (999px) buttons and chips, 1px hairline borders that are brighter on the top edge, no hard drop shadows in dark mode.
  • Imagery: real photography of skylines, trading desks and people at work, graded dark with an ember tint, plus 3D glossy accents (gold coins, shield, trophy, rocket) used sparingly. No purple/violet, no blue-SaaS gradients, no stock “handshake” clichés, no emoji.
  • Motion: a slow breathing glow (8s), counting numbers, price digits that flash green/red when they change, cards that rise 12px with a 50ms stagger, and a CTA shimmer every 6s. All of it honours prefers-reduced-motion.

Logo usage

  • Files: brand/kalks_logo_white.png (on dark) and brand/kalks_logo_black.png (on light). Request SVG masters from the designer before launch; PNG is the fallback.
  • Never redraw, recolour, stretch, outline or add effects to the wordmark. Minimum clear space equals the height of the “K”. Minimum width is 88px on screen.
  • The favicon and app icon use the K glyph alone, white on #1E1E24 with a faint ember glow, rounded square.
REF A3Brand

Voice & tone guide

Kalks speaks like a senior trader explaining a desk to a capable colleague: direct, exact and unhurried. Confidence comes from specifics, not superlatives.

Voice principles

PrincipleWhat it meansExample
PreciseNumbers, units and conditions beat adjectives. Say what a thing is and what it costs.“Raw spreads from 0.0 pips plus $3.50 per lot per side.” Not “ultra-low spreads”.
CalmNo hype, no exclamation marks, no urgency tricks. Markets are exciting enough.“Open an account in about three minutes.” Not “Start NOW!!”
CandidName the risk, the fee and the condition in the same breath as the benefit.“Copy trading automates decisions, not outcomes. You can lose money copying any strategy.”
InstitutionalUse the vocabulary of the trade correctly and explain it once, briefly.“Hedging mode lets you hold buy and sell positions on the same symbol at the same time.”
GlobalShort sentences, plain English, no idioms, slang or culture-specific jokes. Everything must translate cleanly into 20+ languages and RTL.“Withdraw to your own USDT-TRC20 wallet.” Not “cash out in a snap”.

Tone by context

ContextToneNotes
Hero and campaign headlinesConfident, short, specificMax 8 words. One idea. Lead with the outcome or the number.
Product explanationsClear and instructiveUse “you”. Steps are numbered. One sentence per idea.
Risk, legal, compliancePlain and seriousNever soften or hide it. Same font size as body copy on the page.
Errors and 404Helpful, lightly warmExplain what happened and give a next step. No jokes about losing money.
Partners (IB)BusinesslikeTalk about economics, tools and payment reliability, not “passive income”.

Words to use and words to avoid

Use
  • precise, precision, clear, transparent, exact
  • trade, trader, position, execution, spread, commission, swap
  • from 0.0 pips, up to 1:2000 (always “from” / “up to”)
  • tools, conditions, control, protect, verify
  • Client Area, Web Terminal, Strategy Builder (proper nouns, capitalised)
  • USDT-TRC20 (always with the network)
  • may, can, could (for outcomes)
  • negative balance protection
  • past performance is not a reliable indicator of future results
  • simulated (for prop funded accounts)
Avoid
  • guaranteed, risk-free, safe investment, sure profit, get rich
  • passive income, financial freedom, quit your job
  • best broker, #1, world-leading, award-winning (unless verified and sourced)
  • no dealing desk, true ECN, STP-only, we never trade against you
  • instant withdrawals (withdrawals are reviewed; say “fast” with a time range)
  • free money, bonus cash (bonuses are non-withdrawable credit)
  • insured, protected by government (unless verified)
  • crypto “coins” for CFDs (say “crypto CFDs”; clients do not own the coin)
  • revolutionary, next-gen, game-changing, unleash, supercharge
  • exclamation marks, ALL CAPS, emoji

Style rules

  • Sentence case for headlines and buttons (“Open live account”, not “Open Live Account”).
  • Buttons start with a verb: Open, Try, Start, Explore, Compare, Download, Contact. Two to four words.
  • Numbers: always digits (“3 steps”), thousands separators (1,000), “1:500” for leverage, “$3.50” for money, “0.0 pips”, “24/5”, “GMT+2/+3” for server time.
  • Symbol names exactly as on the platform: EURUSD, XAUUSD, US30, NAS100, BTCUSD, USOIL.
  • Use British or American English consistently. This document uses British spelling for body copy (e.g. programme, licence as a noun) because the likely licensing jurisdictions use it. Change it globally if counsel prefers otherwise.
  • Asset classes are capitalised when used as product names: Forex, Metals, Indices, Energies, Crypto, Stocks.

REF A5Global elements

Global elements

Components that appear on every page, or across many. Build them once in the layout and drive their text from the i18n catalogue.

1. Top risk-warning bar

  • Placement: a fixed strip above the header on every page, 32px (desktop) / auto height (mobile), background #111114, 12px text in --text-2, with a 2px ember line at the bottom. It cannot be dismissed. It must not be hidden behind the cookie banner.

CFDs are complex instruments and come with a high risk of losing money rapidly due to leverage. [XX]% of retail investor accounts lose money when trading CFDs with this provider. You should consider whether you understand how CFDs work and whether you can afford to take the high risk of losing your money. Read our Risk Disclosure.

Mobile short version: “CFDs are high-risk. [XX]% of retail accounts lose money. Risk Disclosure”

Compliance noteThe [XX]% figure must be calculated by compliance using the method required by the licensing regulator (commonly the trailing 12-month share of retail accounts that lost money) and updated at the frequency the regulator sets, usually quarterly. Store it in brand.config.ts → riskPercent with a last-updated date so it is a single change.

2. Footer disclaimer

Risk warning: Trading Forex and Contracts for Difference (CFDs) on margin carries a high level of risk and may not be suitable for all investors. Leverage can work against you as well as for you. You could lose more than your initial deposit if negative balance protection does not apply to your account. [XX]% of retail investor accounts lose money when trading CFDs with this provider. Before trading, consider your objectives, level of experience and risk appetite, and seek independent advice if necessary. Past performance is not a reliable indicator of future results.

Regulatory information: Kalks is a trading name of [Company legal name], a company registered in [Jurisdiction] under registration number [Company registration no.], with its registered address at [Registered address]. [Company legal name] is authorised and regulated by [Regulator name] under licence number [Licence no.].

Restricted regions: The information on this website is not directed at residents of [Restricted countries], or of any country or jurisdiction where its distribution or use would be contrary to local law or regulation. Kalks does not offer its services to residents of these jurisdictions.

General: The content of this website is for general information only and does not constitute investment advice, a recommendation or an offer to buy or sell any financial instrument. Crypto CFDs are highly volatile; you do not own the underlying digital asset. Copy trading, PAMM, bonuses, contests and prop challenges are subject to their own terms and risk disclosures.

Compliance noteThe restricted-country list must come from counsel. Typically it includes the United States and sanctioned or FATF high-risk jurisdictions, plus any country where the regulator does not permit the offer. Enforce the same list in the Client Area sign-up (D33); the website only discloses it. If Kalks holds more than one licence, render one paragraph per entity and show the entity that serves the visitor’s country first.

3. Cookie banner

  • Bottom-left floating card (max 420px, radius 20, --surface, top-border highlight). It appears on the first visit and stays until the visitor chooses. No analytics or marketing tags fire before consent (Google Consent Mode v2 default = denied).

We use cookies

We use essential cookies to run this website and, with your permission, analytics and marketing cookies to understand how it is used and to measure our campaigns. You can change your choice at any time in Cookie settings.

Accept all→ sets all categories = granted Reject non-essential→ only essential Manage settings→ opens preferences panel

The IB referral parameter (?ref=) is passed to app.kalkstrade.com in the sign-up URL, so attribution does not depend on marketing cookies. See Appendix D8.

5. Language selector

  • A pill in the header and footer showing a circular flag and the ISO code (e.g. EN). It opens a searchable popover listing languages in their own script (English, العربية, हिन्दी, Español…), grouped by region. The choice is stored in a cookie (essential) and in the URL prefix.
  • Proposed launch set (22): English, Arabic, Hindi, Urdu, Bengali, Persian, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French, German, Italian, Polish, Russian, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Malay. Confirm the final list with the translation manager (D146).
  • RTL: Arabic, Urdu and Persian (and Hebrew if added) set dir="rtl" on <html>, mirror the layout with logical CSS properties, and keep numbers, prices and symbol names LTR (<bdi>).
  • Legal documents: if a translation is not yet approved by counsel, show the English version with the note “This document is available in English only. The English version prevails.”
  • Auto-detect: suggest (never force) a language from Accept-Language with a dismissible toast: “View this site in Español?” with the buttons “Switch” and “Stay in English”.

Live price ticker
A horizontally scrolling strip of 12 symbols (bid, 1D change %) fed by the public price WebSocket. The changed digits flash green/red for 400ms. It pauses on hover and falls back to a static snapshot, labelled “Delayed”, if the socket is unavailable.
Final CTA band
Used at the bottom of most pages: an ember-glow card with a headline, one line of copy, the primary and secondary CTA and a small risk line. Each page specifies its own copy.
FAQ accordion

Support launcher

Headline
Questions, answered
Content
What is the minimum deposit?
You can open a Standard or Cent account from $10. Pro starts from $200 and ECN from $500.
How do I deposit and withdraw?
Kalks uses USDT on the Tron (TRC20) network. Deposits are credited after network confirmation. Withdrawals are reviewed and sent to your own USDT-TRC20 address.
Do I need to verify my identity?
You can register, deposit and trade straight away. Identity verification (KYC) is required before your first withdrawal.
Can I practise first?
Yes. Demo accounts are free, use virtual funds and last 10 days. You can refill the balance from the Client Area.
Can I lose more than I deposit?
No. Negative balance protection resets a negative balance to zero, so you cannot lose more than the funds in your account.

04

What is a CFD

Purpose
Mandatory education plus SEO.
Headline
How CFD trading works
Body copy

A Contract for Difference (CFD) is an agreement to exchange the difference in an instrument’s price between the time you open a position and the time you close it. You never own the underlying asset. You trade its price movement.

If you buy (go long) and the price rises, you make a profit; if it falls, you make a loss. If you sell (go short), the opposite applies. Leverage means you only need a fraction of the position’s value as margin, but profits and losses are calculated on the full position size.

Content

Example. You buy 1 lot of XAUUSD (100 oz) at 2,654.30 with 1:500 leverage. The required margin is about $530.86. If gold rises to 2,664.30, your profit is $1,000 before costs. If it falls to 2,644.30, your loss is $1,000. Moves in either direction are magnified by position size.

Risk note
Leverage magnifies both gains and losses. Only trade with money you can afford to lose.
Build notes
An interactive toggle, Buy/Sell and price up/down, animates a small P&L number. Keep the example figures exact; they are computed with contract size 100 oz and 1:500 leverage.

04

FAQ

Content
What is a pip?
For most pairs a pip is the fourth decimal place (0.0001). For JPY pairs it is the second (0.01). On a 1-lot EURUSD position one pip is worth $10.
When is the forex market open?
From Monday 00:05 to Friday 23:55 server time (GMT+2/+3), continuously. Liquidity is highest when the London and New York sessions overlap.
What is the minimum trade size?
0.01 lots (1,000 units of the base currency) on all account types. On Cent accounts, balances are shown in US cents, so small positions are easy to manage.
Do you charge swaps on forex?
Positions held past the daily rollover at 00:00 server time are charged or credited a swap. Wednesday carries a triple swap for the weekend. Swap-free accounts are available on request.

04

FAQ

Content
How much is one pip on gold?
On XAUUSD one point (0.01) on 1 lot (100 oz) is worth $1, and a $1 move in the gold price is worth $100 per lot.
How much margin do I need for 1 lot of gold?
Margin = price × 100 oz ÷ leverage. At 2,654.30 and 1:500, that is about $530.86. At 1:100 it is about $2,654.30.
Why does gold have a daily break?
The underlying market pauses briefly each day around the rollover. No new orders can be placed during the break; existing stop and limit orders stay active.

04

FAQ

Content
Are indices cash or futures based?
Most of our indices are cash-based and have no expiry. Where an index is priced from futures, it rolls over on a published date and we apply an adjustment, so your P&L is not affected by the price gap between contracts.
Do dividends affect my index position?
Yes. On ex-dividend dates of index constituents, a dividend adjustment is credited to long positions and debited from short positions on cash indices.
What moves index prices?
Earnings of the largest constituents, interest-rate expectations, economic data and overall risk sentiment.

04

FAQ

Content
What is the difference between WTI and Brent?
WTI (USOIL) is the US benchmark, priced at Cushing, Oklahoma. Brent (UKOIL) is the international benchmark from the North Sea. They usually move together but can diverge on regional supply.
Why does oil rollover matter?
Oil CFDs are priced from futures that expire monthly. On the rollover date we move to the next contract and apply a price adjustment, so the change of contract does not create an artificial profit or loss.
What events move oil prices?
Weekly US inventory reports, OPEC+ decisions, geopolitical events and global growth data.

Dividends and splits, handled for you

FAQ

Content
Do I get voting rights or own the shares?
No. A stock CFD tracks the share price. You do not own the share and have no voting rights.
Can I trade stocks outside US market hours?
No. Stock CFDs trade only during the US cash session, 16:30–23:00 server time. Orders can be placed while the market is closed and are processed at the open, subject to gaps.
What happens at earnings?
Share prices can gap sharply after earnings, which are usually released outside market hours. Stop orders may be filled at a worse price than requested.

04

Hedging vs netting

Headline
Hedging or netting: you choose
Body copy

Hedging lets you hold several positions on the same symbol, including buys and sells at the same time. Each position has its own stop loss and take profit, and you can close one against another with Close By.

Netting keeps one net position per symbol. A new order in the same direction adds to it; an opposite order reduces, closes or reverses it. For example, if you are long 1 lot and sell 3 lots, you become short 2 lots.

Build notes
Two side-by-side animated diagrams showing position stacks (hedging: separate rows; netting: a single bar that shrinks, then flips).

02

Spreads #spreads

Headline
Spreads
Body copy

The spread is the difference between the buy (ask) and sell (bid) price and is the main cost of trading on Standard, Pro and Cent accounts. Kalks spreads are variable: they follow market liquidity and are usually tightest when the major sessions overlap. They can widen around major news, at the daily rollover and when markets are thin.

The typical spreads we publish are median values during liquid hours. Live spreads are always shown in the Web Terminal before you trade.

03

Commissions #commissions

Headline
Commissions
Body copy

Standard, Pro and Cent accounts have no commission: the cost is built into the spread. ECN accounts pay raw spreads plus a commission of $3.50 per standard lot per side ($7.00 per round turn) on Forex and Metals. Commissions for other asset classes on ECN are shown in the symbol specifications.

Content

Example: 2 lots EURUSD on ECN = $3.50 × 2 to open + $3.50 × 2 to close = $14.00 in commission, plus the raw spread.

04

Leverage #leverage

Headline
Leverage
Body copy

Leverage lets you open a position larger than your margin. You choose the account leverage when you open the account, from the options for that account type. The effective leverage for each position is the lower of the account leverage and the instrument’s maximum (for example, 1:20 for stock CFDs).

To manage risk around market closures, Kalks may temporarily reduce the leverage available on new positions before weekends and holidays and around major scheduled news. These periods are announced in the Client Area in advance whenever possible. You can change your account leverage in the Client Area when the account has no open positions.

05

Margin, margin call and stop-out #margin

Headline
Margin and stop-out
Body copy

Margin is the amount set aside to keep a position open: Margin = (Lots × Contract size × Price) ÷ Leverage. Margin level = Equity ÷ Used margin × 100%.

If your margin level falls to the margin call level, we notify you by email and in-app so you can add funds or reduce positions. If it falls to the stop-out level, the system automatically starts closing positions, beginning with the largest losing position, until the margin level is restored above the stop-out level.

Content

Standard100%50%
Pro100%50%
ECN100%50%
Cent60%20%

Hedged positions: when you hold opposite positions on the same symbol in hedging mode, margin is charged on the hedged volume at a reduced rate of [Hedged margin %] of the normal requirement.

Build notes
Include an inline margin calculator widget (the same component as /tools/calculators) prefilled with XAUUSD 1 lot at 1:500.
06

Swaps #swaps

Headline
Swaps (overnight financing)
Body copy

A swap is an interest adjustment charged or credited on positions held open past the daily rollover at 00:00 server time. It reflects the interest-rate difference between the two currencies (or the financing cost of the instrument) plus a Kalks fee. Swap rates are set per symbol, separately for long and short positions, and are shown in the symbol specifications in the Web Terminal.

On Wednesday night a triple swap is applied to Forex and Metals to cover the weekend. For Indices and Energies the triple-swap day may differ (usually Friday). Crypto CFDs are charged a swap every day, including weekends.

07

Swap-free #swap-free

Headline
Swap-free (Islamic) option
Body copy

Swap-free status is available on all account types for clients who cannot pay or receive interest for religious reasons. No swap is charged or credited. For some instruments, a fixed administration fee may apply once a position has been held for more than [Islamic fee-free nights] nights; the fee is displayed in the symbol specifications. Kalks may review or revoke swap-free status if it is used for carry-trade or arbitrage purposes.

08

Trading hours #hours

Headline
Trading hours
Body copy

All times are server time: GMT+2 in winter and GMT+3 when US daylight saving time is in effect. This keeps the daily rollover aligned with the New York close. Exact sessions and holiday schedules for every symbol are in the Web Terminal and are announced in the Client Area before each holiday.

A “Markets open now” widget: a 24h horizontal timeline per asset class with a moving “now” marker and the next holiday closure.
09

Execution #execution

Headline
Order execution
Body copy

All accounts use market execution: your order is filled at the best available price when it reaches our servers. You can set a maximum deviation (slippage tolerance) in the order ticket. If the price moves beyond it before execution, the order is not filled and you are shown the new price.

Slippage can be positive or negative, and it is applied symmetrically. Stop orders become market orders when triggered and may be filled at a worse price during gaps or fast markets. Limit orders are filled at your price or better.

Kalks acts as the counterparty to your trades. [Execution model disclosure]. Full details are in our Order Execution Policy.

Content
Order typesExpiry optionsAlso supported
Market, Limit, Stop, Stop-LimitGood-till-cancelled, Today, Specific dateServer-side trailing stop, partial close, Close By (hedging), OCO brackets, one-click trading
10

Negative balance protection #nbp

Headline
Negative balance protection
Body copy

If a sharp market move takes your account balance below zero, Kalks resets it to zero at no cost to you. You can never lose more than the funds in your trading account. Negative balance protection applies per trading account and does not apply to losses offset against other accounts or to accounts involved in abuse of this protection.

How to deposit

Headline
Deposit in three steps
Content
  1. Open your wallet. In the Client Area, go to Wallet → Deposit and choose USDT (TRC20). You will see your personal deposit address and QR code. It is unique to you and does not change.
  2. Send USDT on TRC20. From your exchange or wallet, withdraw USDT to that address, and select the Tron (TRC20) network.
  3. Get credited automatically. After network confirmation, the USDT appears in your wallet. Move it to any trading account instantly; USDT converts 1:1 to USD (or 1 USDT = 100 USC on Cent accounts).
Risk note

04

How to withdraw

Headline
Withdraw in four steps
Content
  1. Verify your identity. Complete identity verification (KYC) once, before your first withdrawal. It usually takes a few minutes.
  2. Move funds to your wallet. Transfer from your trading account to your wallet. The amount must be available as free margin.
  3. Request the withdrawal. Enter the amount and your own USDT-TRC20 address, then confirm with the one-time code sent to your email.
  4. Receive your USDT. Our team reviews the request, then it is sent on-chain. You will see the transaction ID (TXID) in your history.

Security of funds

Body copy

Each client has a unique deposit address generated from Kalks’s own wallet infrastructure. Deposits are swept to cold storage, and only the amount needed for day-to-day withdrawals is kept in a hot wallet. FAQ

Content
My deposit has not arrived. What should I do?
Check that you sent USDT on the Tron (TRC20) network to the address shown in your Client Area, and that the transaction shows as confirmed on a Tron explorer. Most deposits arrive within minutes of confirmation. If it has been more than 30 minutes, contact support with your TXID.
I sent funds on the wrong network. Can you recover them?
Recovery is not always possible. Contact support with your TXID; if recovery is technically possible, a recovery fee of [Recovery fee] may apply.
Why is my withdrawal pending?
Every withdrawal is reviewed for your protection. Reviews are usually completed within [Withdrawal review time]. We will email you if we need anything else.
Can I withdraw to an exchange address?
Yes, as long as the address is on the Tron (TRC20) network and the exchange account is in your name.
Do you accept bank cards or bank transfers?
Not at the moment. Kalks accepts USDT-TRC20. You can buy USDT on most major exchanges with a card or bank transfer and then deposit it.

PAMM

PAMM (Percentage Allocation Management Module) is a pooled managed account. The concepts (NAV units, rollover, high-water mark) must be explained plainly, with a worked example.

01

Headline

CTAs

Imagery
A fund card mock-up: manager portrait, fund name, NAV per unit 1.2418 (illustrative), a 1Y NAV line in gold over a dotted grid, max drawdown, performance fee, rollover “Weekly”. Label: “Illustrative example”.
02

How PAMM works

Content
  1. Units, not trades. A PAMM fund is one trading account managed by a manager. When you invest, you buy units at the fund’s net asset value (NAV) per unit.
  2. Profits and losses are shared by units. As the manager trades, the NAV rises or falls. Your share of the result equals your share of the units.
  3. Rollover. Investments, withdrawals and fees are processed at the fund’s rollover (daily, weekly or monthly, set by the manager). Requests made between rollovers are queued.
  4. Redeem. Request a withdrawal at any time; your units are redeemed at the next rollover NAV, subject to any lock-in period shown on the fund page.
03

Worked example

Content

You invest $1,000 when the NAV is 1.2500 per unit, so you receive 800 units. By the next rollover, the manager has grown the fund and the NAV is 1.3000. Your units are now worth $1,040. The fund’s performance fee is 20% of new profit above the high-water mark: 20% × $40 = $8. Your value after fees is $1,032. If the NAV later falls and then recovers, no fee is charged until it passes its previous high again.

Build notes
Present as an animated 3-step calculator with editable amount and NAV fields; the calculations update live.
04

Protection

Bullets
  • Investor stop-loss: choose a level (e.g. −20%); if your investment falls to it, your units are redeemed automatically
  • Fund drawdown freeze: if a fund reaches its maximum drawdown limit, trading is frozen for review
  • Manager commitment: managers must keep a minimum share of their own capital in the fund
  • High-water mark: fees only on new profits, per investor

No. The manager can only trade the fund’s account. Only you can redeem your units, and payments always go to your own Kalks wallet.
When is the performance fee charged?
At each rollover, only on profit above your personal high-water mark.

How it works

05

Scaling plan

Headline
Grow with consistency
Body copy

Every 3 months, if your funded account is up at least 10% over the period and you have received at least 2 payouts, your account size increases by 25% and your profit split rises by 5 percentage points, up to 90%. Accounts can scale to a maximum of [Maximum scaled account size].

06

Prohibited strategies

Body copy

To keep evaluations fair, the following are not allowed and lead to failure of the challenge or funded account: latency or tick arbitrage, tick scalping that exploits price feed delays, high-frequency trading, copying trades between accounts or with other traders, hedging across accounts, and any practice that takes advantage of simulated execution rather than market skill. Violations are detected automatically and reviewed by our risk team.

07

Breach handling

Body copy

If you breach the daily loss limit or maximum loss, the account fails automatically and all positions are closed. You can start a new challenge at any time, and returning traders receive [Retry discount] off their next challenge.

08

FAQ

Content
Is the funded account real money?
No. Challenge and funded accounts are simulated. Your payouts are rewards paid by Kalks, based on your simulated performance under the rules.
Which instruments can I trade?
Forex, Metals, Indices, Energies and Crypto CFDs. Stock CFDs are not available on prop accounts.
How is the daily loss limit calculated?
It is measured from the higher of your balance or equity at the start of each trading day (00:00 server time). Floating losses count toward the limit.
Can I use automated strategies or the API?
Yes, as long as the strategy is not prohibited (see above) and is not shared across other traders’ accounts.
Do I need to verify my identity?
Yes, before you receive a funded account and before any payout.
How do I get paid?
Request a payout from your prop dashboard. After review, it is credited to your Kalks wallet, and you can withdraw it in USDT-TRC20.
What happens if I fail?
The account closes. You can buy a new challenge at any time, with [Retry discount] off as a returning trader.
Can I hold several challenges?
Yes, up to a combined funded allocation of [Maximum combined allocation].

FAQ

Content
Does it cost anything to become a partner?
No. The programme is free to join.
When and how am I paid?
Commissions accumulate as pending and are paid to your Kalks wallet in scheduled batches (daily, weekly or monthly, depending on your deal) after review. You can withdraw them in USDT-TRC20.
Can I see my clients’ trades?
Yes. You can see client activity and the trades that generate your commission, in line with our privacy policy and the consent clients give at sign-up.
Do I need to be a client myself?
You need a Kalks Client Area account to receive payouts. You do not need to trade.
Can I offer my clients a rebate?
Yes. You can share part of your rate with your clients as a rebate from your dashboard.

Calculators

Content
Tab (#anchor)InputsOutputsFormula / notes
Position size (#position-size)Account currency, balance, risk % or amount, stop loss (pips/points), symbolLot size, risk amount, pip valueLots = Risk amount ÷ (SL in pips × pip value per lot). Round down to the lot step (0.01).
Pip value (#pip-value)Symbol, lot size, account currencyValue of one pip/pointPip value = Pip size × Contract size × Lots, converted to the account currency at the live rate.
Margin (#margin)Symbol, lot size, leverage, account typeRequired marginMargin = Lots × Contract size × Price ÷ min(account leverage, instrument max leverage).
Profit / loss (#profit)Symbol, direction, lots, open price, close priceP&L in account currency (and USC for Cent), pipsP&L = (Close − Open) × Contract size × Lots (reversed for sells), converted.
Swap (#swap)Symbol, direction, lots, nightsSwap cost or creditUses the live swap long/short per symbol and applies the triple-swap day.
Currency converter (#converter)Amount, from, toConverted amountMid-market rate, for information only.

02

Explainer copy

Headline
Size every trade before you place it
Body copy

Professional traders decide how much they are prepared to lose before they enter a trade. Use the position size calculator to turn that risk into the right lot size for your stop loss. Results are estimates based on current prices and contract specifications and do not include spread, commission or slippage.

03

FAQ

Content
How much should I risk per trade?
There is no single right answer. Many traders risk a small, fixed percentage of their balance, such as 1–2%, so that a series of losses does not seriously damage their account.
Why does my margin differ from the calculator?
Margin can be higher around weekends, holidays or major news, and hedged positions use a reduced rate. The terminal always shows the exact margin before you confirm.

Conditions you can verify

04

Protection of client funds #funds

Headline
How we look after your funds
Bullets
  • [Client funds segregation statement]
  • Own custody, mostly offline. Crypto deposits go to a unique address generated for you from our own wallet infrastructure. Funds are swept to cold storage, and only what is needed for daily withdrawals is kept in an online hot wallet.
  • Daily reconciliation. Every day we reconcile balances on the blockchain, in client wallets and in trading accounts. Any difference is investigated before withdrawals continue.
  • Every withdrawal reviewed. Withdrawals are checked against your identity, account activity and device history, and paid only to a wallet in your name.
  • Negative balance protection. Your trading account balance cannot fall below zero.
05

Account security #security

Headline
Security built into every account
Bullets
  • Email one-time passcodes for new-device logins, withdrawals and changes to passwords or credentials
  • See every active session and log out other devices in one click
  • Separate trading and investor (read-only) passwords for each trading account
  • View-only logins for your accountant or mentor, with an expiry date and revocation at any time
  • API keys with read-only or trade scopes, IP allow-lists and expiry. API keys can never withdraw funds
  • Encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest; wallet keys held in dedicated key-management systems, never in plain text
06

Fair trading #fair-trading

Headline
Fair and transparent trading
Body copy

Our Order Execution Policy explains how your orders are handled, including slippage, which applies in both directions. Every order is tagged with its source (manual, API, strategy, copy or PAMM) and recorded in your history. If a trade ever has to be corrected because of a clear pricing error, the correction is shown on your statement with an explanation. Staff actions on client accounts are recorded in an audit log that cannot be altered.

CTAs
Read the Order Execution Policy→ /legal/order-execution-policy
07

Responsible trading

Body copy

Leveraged trading is not suitable for everyone. We give you tools to stay in control: demo accounts, risk calculators, margin alerts, analytics that flag overtrading, and the option to reduce your leverage. If you feel that trading is affecting your wellbeing or finances, contact support and we can help you restrict or close your account.

Getting started 6

How do I open a Kalks account?
Select “Open account”, enter your email, phone number and a password, and verify both with one-time codes. It takes about three minutes. You can then open trading accounts and deposit straight away.
Who can open an account?
Individuals aged 18 or over, and companies, who are not residents of a restricted region. The list of restricted regions is in the footer of every page and in our Client Agreement.
Can I open a corporate account?
Yes. Choose “Corporate” during registration. Verification requires incorporation documents and details of directors, ultimate beneficial owners and authorised traders.
Is there a demo account?
Yes. Demo accounts are free, use virtual funds on real-time prices, last 10 days and can be refilled from the Client Area.
Can I sign up with Google?
Yes. You can register and log in with Google or with your email and password. Phone verification is still required.
What languages do you support?
The website, Client Area, Web Terminal and support are available in 20+ languages, including Arabic and other right-to-left languages.

Accounts 7

Which account type should I choose?
Cent suits small, real-money testing; Standard suits most traders; Pro offers tighter spreads for active traders; ECN offers raw spreads plus commission for scalpers and algorithms. See the Account types page for a full comparison.
What is the difference between hedging and netting?
Hedging lets you hold several positions, including opposite ones, on the same symbol. Netting keeps one net position per symbol: opposite orders reduce or reverse it.
How many accounts can I open?
You can hold several live and demo accounts in one Client Area, up to the limit shown when you open a new account.
Can I change my leverage?
Yes, from the Client Area, as long as the account has no open positions. You can choose from the options available for your account type.
What is a Cent account?
An account whose balance is shown in US cents (USC). $10 appears as 1,000 USC. Lot sizes are the same as on standard accounts.
How do I get a swap-free account?
Request swap-free status from the account settings in the Client Area. It is available on all account types, subject to approval.
What are the trading and investor passwords?
Each trading account has a trading password for full access and an investor password that gives read-only access to the terminal. You can change both in the Client Area after confirming with an email code.

Deposits & withdrawals 8

Which payment methods do you accept?
USDT on the Tron (TRC20) network. More networks and coins will be added and listed on the Deposits & withdrawals page.
How long do deposits take?
Usually a few minutes after the transaction is confirmed on the Tron network. Crediting is automatic.
Are there any deposit fees?
Kalks does not charge a deposit fee. Your exchange or wallet may charge a network fee to send USDT.
What is the minimum deposit?
The minimum wallet deposit is 10 USDT. Account minimums are $10 (Standard, Cent), $200 (Pro) and $500 (ECN).
How do I withdraw?
Move funds from your trading account to your wallet, request a withdrawal to your own USDT-TRC20 address, and confirm with the email code. The request is reviewed and then sent on-chain.
How long do withdrawals take?
Requests are reviewed within [Withdrawal review time] and then sent on-chain, which usually takes a few minutes. You will see the transaction ID in your history.
Why was my withdrawal rejected?
Common reasons are incomplete identity verification, an address on the wrong network, insufficient free margin, or an address not in your name. The rejection email explains the reason and what to do next.
How does USDT convert to my account currency?
USDT converts 1:1 to USD when you transfer it to a trading account. On Cent accounts 1 USDT becomes 100 USC.

Verification & security 6

When do I need to verify my identity?
Before your first withdrawal. You can register, deposit and trade before verifying.
What documents do I need?
A government-issued photo ID (front and back), a proof of address dated within the last three months, and a quick selfie or liveness check.
How long does verification take?
Most verifications are completed automatically within minutes. Some are reviewed manually, which can take up to [KYC manual review time].
Can I change my name or date of birth?
Not after verification. Contact support with supporting documents if a correction is needed. Changing your address or phone number requires re-verification.
How is my account protected?
Email one-time codes protect new-device logins, withdrawals and credential changes. You can view active sessions and log out other devices at any time.
I received a message asking for my password. Is it from Kalks?
No. Kalks will never ask for your password, one-time codes or wallet private keys. Report the message to [Compliance email].

Trading 8

What are your trading hours?
Forex trades 24/5, Metals and Energies 24/5 with a daily break, Indices by exchange session, Stocks during the US session, and Crypto 24/7. All times are server time, GMT+2/+3.
What is a margin call and stop-out?
A margin call warns you when your margin level falls to your account’s margin-call level. At the stop-out level, positions are closed automatically, starting with the largest loss.
Can I lose more than my deposit?
No. Negative balance protection resets a negative balance to zero.
What order types can I use?
Market, Limit, Stop and Stop-Limit, with trailing stops, OCO brackets, partial close and Close By in hedging mode.
What is slippage?
The difference between the requested price and the fill price in fast markets. It can be positive or negative. You can set a maximum deviation in the order ticket.
When are swaps charged?
At 00:00 server time on positions held overnight, with a triple swap on Wednesday for Forex and Metals. Crypto swaps apply every day.
Do you allow scalping, hedging and automated trading?
Yes. Scalping, hedging and automated trading are allowed on live accounts, provided they do not exploit pricing errors or latency. Prop accounts have additional rules.
Why did my spread widen?
Spreads are variable and can widen at the daily rollover, around major news and when liquidity is low.

Platforms 5

Do I need to download anything?
No. The Web Terminal runs in your browser. On mobile, you can install the Kalks app from your browser in two taps.
Do you offer MetaTrader?
Kalks uses its own Web Terminal with in-house charts, available in the browser and on mobile. For automation, use the Strategy Builder or our API.
How do I get API access?
Create an API key for any trading account in the Client Area under API & Algo. Keys can be read-only or trade-enabled and never allow withdrawals.
Is FIX available?
Yes, FIX 4.4 is available on request for institutional clients. Contact the API team.
Can I run a strategy while my computer is off?
Yes. Strategies deployed from the Strategy Builder run 24/7 on Kalks servers.

Copy trading, PAMM & prop 6

What is the difference between copy trading and PAMM?
In copy trading, the provider’s trades are mirrored into your own copy account with your own settings. In PAMM, you buy units in a pooled fund managed by a manager, and results are shared by units at each rollover.
How are performance fees charged?
Only on new profits above a high-water mark, at settlement. No subscription or management fees.
Can I stop copying at any time?
Yes. When you stop, you can close the copied positions or keep them open in your copy account.
Are prop funded accounts real money?
No. Prop challenge and funded accounts are simulated. Payouts are rewards paid by Kalks based on your simulated performance under the plan rules.
How do prop payouts work?
Request a payout from your prop dashboard after the minimum period. After review, it is credited to your Kalks wallet for withdrawal.
Can I lose money with copy trading or PAMM?
Yes. You can lose some or all of the money you allocate. Past performance is not a reliable indicator of future results.

Partners 4

How do I become a partner?
Every Kalks client is automatically a Level 1 partner with a referral link. You can also register directly as a partner.
How are commissions calculated?
Per standard lot on your referred clients’ closed live trades, at the rate for your level and the symbol group, plus your share from sub-partners.
When are commissions paid?
In scheduled batches to your Kalks wallet after review.
Can I move a client to my network?
Client attribution is permanent from registration. Only Kalks can reassign a client, in exceptional cases.
Content noteAnswers are written to stay true when parameters change, but a few reference configurable values (fees, limits, review times). Render those from the same config source as the rest of the site, or review this page whenever the admin configuration changes.

LayerChoiceNotes
FrameworkNext.js (App Router) + React + TypeScriptNew app apps/website in the existing pnpm + Turborepo monorepo; local port :3003 (D21). Use static generation (SSG) and incremental static regeneration (ISR, revalidate 60–300s) for marketing pages; live data is hydrated on the client.
StylingTailwind CSS v4 + design tokens from packages/uiReuse the CSS variables in D2. shadcn/ui (Radix) primitives for accordion, tabs, dialog, popover and select.
MotionMotion (framer-motion), GSAP for count-ups and hero, React Bits components sparingly (SplitText, SpotlightCard, CountUp)Every animation is gated by prefers-reduced-motion.
ChartsIn-house, built on the open-source lightweight-charts librarySparklines, hero charts, calculators. The full terminal is a separate app.

DataPublic read-only endpoints on api.kalkstrade.com/public/*account-groups, symbols, quotes (WS), payment-methods, prop/plans, ib/levels, copy/masters, calendar, news. Cache at the edge (60s), never expose private data.

Load Geist and Geist Mono with the geist npm package (next/font), with font-display: swap and preloading of the 400/600 weights only. Fallbacks: Inter, system-ui.

Shape, spacing, elevation

  • Radius: 20 for cards, 14 for inner rows, 999 for pills, chips, icon buttons and CTAs.
  • Spacing: 8px grid; section padding 120px desktop / 72px mobile; card padding 24; gaps 16–20; max content width 1280 (website) with 1600 for full-bleed terminal images.
  • Elevation: no hard shadows in dark mode. Depth comes from the card gradient, the brighter top border and the ember glow.
  • Highlighted card: an ember→dark gradient with a faint drifting star-particle texture (the Pro account, the final CTA band).

Motion rules

  • Ambient glow breathes (opacity .85↔1, 8s ease-in-out, infinite).
  • Reveal: fade + 12px rise, 50ms stagger, 400ms, easeOut; triggered once at 20% visibility.
  • Numbers count up in 1.2s (easeOutExpo); live prices flash only the changed digits for 400ms.
  • CTA shimmer sweep every 6s; hover on cards brightens border-top and adds a cursor spotlight.
  • Chart lines draw in over 900ms; gauges sweep over 900ms.
  • Reduced motion: disable marquee, parallax, shimmer, particles and count-ups (show final values).

Image sourcing & art direction

Real, premium, dark and warm. Photography should look like it was shot for Kalks, not taken from a stock catalogue.

Sources

TypeSourceRules
Skylines, desks, citiesUnsplash / Pexels (free licence) or licensed Getty/Adobe Stock for hero imagesReuse the curated photos already in packages/assets (skyline, London, New York, Singapore) for consistency with the Client Area. Keep a licence record per image in assets/LICENSES.md.
PeopleLicensed stock with model releases, or real Kalks staffDiverse, professional, natural poses. Never present stock models as clients, masters or staff; add an “Illustrative” label where context could suggest a real person.
Product screenshotsCaptured from the real apps (CRM :3000, terminal)Use seeded demo data (mock names such as Arjun Mehta, logins such as 80412337). Capture at 2× and dark theme. Blur or replace anything resembling real client data.
3D glossy accentsCommissioned or licensed 3D set (coins, BTC coin, shield, trophy, rocket, wallet, bar chart)Ember/gold palette only; no violet. Export as WebP/AVIF with transparency at 1× and 2×.
LogosOfficial brand kits (USDT, TRON, BTC, ETH, SOL, company logos for stocks)Use for identification only, following each brand’s guidelines. TradingView attribution where required.
Flagsflag-icons (circular crop)SVG, lazy-loaded.

Colour grade

  • Lift blacks slightly and crush them toward #07070A; reduce saturation 20–30%; add an ember (#FF5A1F) split-tone in the highlights and a subtle top-down vignette so the page glow blends into the photo.
  • Apply the grade consistently with a shared LUT; export in AVIF with a WebP fallback; hero images ≤ 180 KB at 1600px wide.
  • Avoid: purple/blue neon, bull/bear statues, piles of cash, luxury-lifestyle imagery (cars, yachts), handshake clichés and casino visuals.

Alt text

Describe what the image shows and why it matters, e.g. “Kalks Web Terminal showing a gold chart with take-profit and stop-loss lines”. Decorative images use empty alt. Alt text must also follow the no-profit-promise rule.

REF D5Developer appendix

SEO & structured data

Technical SEO and the schema types assigned to each page in Part B.

Technical SEO

  • Titles and meta descriptions exactly as specified per page (the build script enforces title ≤ 60 and description ≤ 155 characters). Translate them per locale, with length checks per language.
  • One H1 per page, as specified. Logical H2/H3 hierarchy following the section order.
  • Canonical URL on every page. hreflang alternates for every locale plus x-default (English). Locale prefix routing: / (en), /ar/, /es/…
  • XML sitemaps split by type (pages, academy, glossary, briefs, legal) with lastmod; robots.txt allows everything except /api, search results and preview routes; 404 and redirect routes are noindex.
  • Server-render all indexable content (tables, FAQs, copy). Hydrate live prices after load; never block content on WebSocket data.
  • Open Graph and Twitter cards per page: 1200×630 images auto-generated with @vercel/og (dark background, ember glow, page H1, Kalks logo).
  • Internal linking: every asset-class page links to account types, conditions and calculators; academy lessons link to relevant market pages and glossary terms.
  • Core pages must not be rendered only by client-side JavaScript. Breadcrumbs appear on every inner page.
  • Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster verified; submit sitemaps; monitor Core Web Vitals by template.

REF D6Developer appendix

Performance, accessibility & release checklist

Targets measured on a mid-range Android device over 4G (Lighthouse mobile preset) and on real-user monitoring (RUM).

Performance budget

MetricTarget (p75, mobile)
Largest Contentful Paint≤ 2.0 s
Interaction to Next Paint≤ 200 ms
Cumulative Layout Shift≤ 0.05
Time to First Byte≤ 400 ms (edge cached)
JS on first load (home)≤ 170 KB gzipped
Lighthouse Performance / SEO / Best Practices / Accessibility≥ 90 / 100 / 100 / 100
  • Static generation + edge caching; stream the live parts (ticker, tables) as client islands.
  • Load the WebSocket only after the page is idle; throttle UI updates to 2/s per symbol; pause when the tab is hidden.
  • next/image with AVIF/WebP, explicit width/height, lazy-load below the fold, priority for the hero image only.
  • Videos: muted, playsinline, poster, preload=none, max 2 MB; no autoplay under reduced motion or Save-Data.
  • Fonts: subset Latin + Arabic + Devanagari etc. per locale; preload only the weights used above the fold.
  • Third-party scripts (analytics, chat, CMP) are deferred and load after consent where required; chat loads on first interaction.

Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)

  • Colour contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for body text (check --text-2 on --surface; use --text for small text on glows).
  • Never rely on colour alone for price direction: add ▲/▼ glyphs or +/− signs next to green/red values.
  • Keyboard: all menus, tabs, accordions, sliders and calculators are operable; visible focus ring (2px ember outline + 2px offset); skip-to-content link.
  • Live price regions are not announced continuously (aria-live off); calculators announce results politely.
  • Semantic tables with <th scope>; captions for instrument tables.
  • Motion: honour prefers-reduced-motion; pause controls for the marquee (WCAG 2.2.2).
  • Forms: labels, error messages linked with aria-describedby, no CAPTCHA puzzles without an accessible alternative.
  • RTL: logical properties, mirrored icons where directional, numbers kept LTR.
  • Target size ≥ 24×24 px (WCAG 2.5.8); language attribute set per page.

Release checklist

  1. No [bracketed placeholder] remains in any locale (automated grep in CI fails the build).
  2. Every value marked for verification is either API-driven or signed off against the admin configuration.
  3. The [XX]% risk figure is set, dated and approved by compliance.
  4. Legal documents published from counsel-approved text, with version and effective date.
  5. Restricted-country list is identical on the website disclosure and in the Client Area enforcement.
  6. Regulator badge and regulation copy hidden unless the licence is live.
  7. All CTAs resolve to live app.kalkstrade.com routes with lang/ref/UTM preserved.
  8. Consent: no analytics or marketing tags fire before consent (checked with the network panel).
  9. Lighthouse and axe checks pass on every template; manual screen-reader pass (VoiceOver, NVDA) on home, accounts and funding.
  10. Redirects, sitemap, robots, hreflang and structured data validated (Rich Results Test).
  11. Status page, 404 and 500 pages tested; error monitoring (e.g. Sentry) connected.

Funnels and attribution

  • Primary funnel: landing → cta_click → signup_start → (app) registration_complete → first_deposit → first_trade. App-side events are tracked by the Client Area and joined by an anonymous visitor ID passed as ?vid= together with UTM and ref.
  • Partner attribution: ?ref=CODE stored for 90 days in first-party storage and appended to all app links (essential for the service, disclosed in the Cookie Policy); the IB’s campaign link ID (?cid=) feeds the partner funnel (D62).
  • Report weekly: conversion rate by page template and locale, CTA click-through by section, calculator usage, prop plan mix, partner sign-ups.
